criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT, pp.1-3. Five lettered pathways A-E for coverage, then one not-covered list. ICD-10 'codes that support medical necessity' in Billing/Coding (p.4-5) are a loose diagnosis screen, not mapped to A-E. Reimbursement and Definitions add nothing to criteria.
procedures_covered: Mohs micrographic surgery (CPT 17311-17315): one procedure, many indications

logic.top_level: pathways: 'meets the definition of medical necessity when performed for ONE of the following indications' A-E, each a diagnosis x anatomic location x host/status combination; followed by a 'does not meet' list that partly mirrors it

k_of_n.quote: meets the definition of medical necessity when performed for ONE of the following indications:

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Written as a second list ('does not meet the definition of medical necessity for all other indications and including but not limited to') of cancer type x site x size x host status. It is both a catch-all and an enumerated NOT list. Sub-bullets use size ceilings (<=2 cm, <=1 cm) for healthy vs immunocompromised members.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: No separate repeat criteria for later stages. 'Recurrent' vs 'primary' is a lesion attribute inside pathways C and D, and in the exclusions ('Recurrent superficial BCC ... of any size').

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Superficial (except on trunk and extremities ) BCC of any size or unexpected positive margin on recent excision (healthy or immunocompromised members with genetic syndromes)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Parenthetical 'healthy or immunocompromised members with genetic syndromes' can attach to either or both of the two conditions; unclear if 'with genetic syndromes' modifies only immunocompromised.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: B. ... that are in anatomic locations listed above (A), trunk, and extremities, regardless of subtype, size, or depth, in: Prior radiated skin / Traumatic scar / ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Items after 'in:' are an implicit OR list; nothing says OR. Also 'listed above (A)' means the A list, so B = A-sites + trunk + extremities.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: D. Lentigo maligna, melanoma in situ, non-lentigo maligna – primary or locally recurrent in anatomic locations listed above (B).
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'listed above (B)' - B is a list of conditions on top of A sites, not a site list, so the referent is an inference.

vague_terms.problem: neither 'healthy' nor 'immunocompromised' defined; the exclusion size cutoffs depend on it.

vague_terms.quote: unexpected positive margin on recent excision

vague_terms.problem: the not-covered list is open; absence from the covered list A-E is the real test.

extraction_hazards: Pathway letters A-E are inconsistently indented in pdftotext: A is indented, B-E start at the left margin, so indentation cannot be trusted to find nesting.

Bullets in this file are the private-use glyph U+F0B7 (36 of them, invisible in many viewers) rather than a visible bullet; sub-bullets under the not-covered list render as a literal 'o'. A parser must treat U+F0B7 as a bullet.
Stray space inside parentheses ('trunk and extremities )'), mixed spelling 'vermillion', 'Mohs' vs 'Mohs’' apostrophes.
Coding section is a three-column table flattened into 'code  long descriptor' with hanging indents; CPT descriptors repeat nearly verbatim for 17311/17313 etc.
LOINC documentation table (Reimbursement section) is a 4-column table flattened; same six-month sentence repeats per row.
The Position Statement NOTE about surgeon-and-pathologist is repeated verbatim in Description, Position Statement and Reimbursement.
interesting_structures: Coverage defined by an anatomic-site x histology x host-status matrix with size ceilings on the NOT side (the covered side has no sizes).
'Mask areas' of face is a named region with an embedded inclusion list.
Billing rule inside the clinical policy: not Mohs unless the same physician is surgeon and pathologist.
LOINC table lists the records a reviewer may request with a six-month look-back (18805-2).

fit_to_tree.why: any-of over five pathways, each an all-of of leaves, fits. Strain comes from the site list needing a lookup table, host-status terms with no definition, 'listed above' back-references, and the NOT list that overlaps pathways. Size thresholds appear only as exclusions.
